help_text:
ℹ️ **HELP & USAGE ETHICS**

• This project is designed **strictly** for personal hygiene of your own Telegram account.
• The tool does not bypass Telegram API limits and respects FloodWait.
• Verification codes and 2FA passwords are never stored on disk.
• Sessions are encrypted at rest with Fernet.
• Deletion cannot guarantee destruction of copies held by third parties (screenshots, forwards, external archives).
• Smart heuristics are advisory and never perform automated actions without your explicit confirmation.
